lines.x: Banxico lowered its benchmark interest rate from 6.5% to 6.25% to stimulate the economy.
The Mexican peso closed at 18.77 per US dollar following monetary commentary from Banxico.
Mexico's public deficit reached US$51.5 billion over the first nine months of 2026, marking an increase of US$11.9 billion since August.
Steel stocks hit a six-month low as Wall Street declined, with Ternium shares falling 5.37 percent and Gerdau dropping 4.57 percent.
